record.original_question: Classify all two-orbit polytopes of full rank, where “full rank” is understood relative to their symmetry type graph: there is no polytope of one higher rank in the same Euclidean space with the same symmetry type graph.

evidence.quote: Problem 23. Describe all two-orbit polytopes of full rank.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
An (abstract) polytope of rank n is a ranked partially ordered set satisfying the usual axioms (existence of least and greatest faces, the diamond condition, strong flag connectivity). A flag of such a polytope is a maximal chain. The automorphism group acts on the set of flags, and a polytope is called a two-orbit polytope if this action has exactly two orbits.

The symmetry type graph of a polytope is the quotient multigraph whose vertices are the flag orbits of the automorphism group and whose i-colored edges record i-adjacency between flags modulo the group action (for i = 0, 1, ..., n−1).

A geometric polytope P realized in some Euclidean space E is said to be of full rank (relative to its symmetry type graph) if there is no polytope of rank one higher than P, realized in the same Euclidean space E, that has the same symmetry type graph as P.

Problem. Classify, up to similarity, all two-orbit polytopes of full rank in this sense; that is, determine all Euclidean realizations of abstract two-orbit polytopes P such that no polytope of strictly higher rank in the same Euclidean space possesses the same symmetry type graph as P.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work has developed the structural theory of two-orbit polytopes and the framework of symmetry type graphs, and full-rank regular polytopes have been classified, but a classification of two-orbit polytopes of full rank in the symmetry-type-graph sense has not been found in the literature. Searches return general theory of two-orbit polytopes and partial results on classes (e.g., infinite 2-orbit polyhedra in classes 2_0 and 2_2), suggesting the full classification remains open.

status_evidence.title: Two-Orbit Polytopes
status_evidence.snippet: Structural theory of two-orbit polytopes: face- and section-transitivity, generators, stabilizers; no general full-rank classification stated.
status_evidence.claim: Provides general structure theory but not a complete full-rank classification of two-orbit polytopes.

status_evidence.title: On infinite 2-orbit polyhedra in classes 2_0 and 2_2
status_evidence.snippet: Studies specific classes of infinite 2-orbit polyhedra.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates partial results restricted to particular classes, consistent with the full problem remaining open.

status_evidence.title: Regular Polytopes of Full Rank
status_evidence.snippet: Classification of regular polytopes of full rank.
status_evidence.claim: The regular (one-orbit) analogue is classified, while the two-orbit version remains a stated open problem.
